create.title: Exact finite t=1 squarefree one-sided reciprocal transform
create.statement_tex: Let R=X^(1/4), N=floor(X), DE asymp M<=R^2, D<=sqrt(M), and retain every half-open t=1 prefix. After target-safe product-width sqrt(M) and cone-width sqrt(D) collars, let P(d) be the exact finite set of odd pairs (alpha,b), b|d, mu(alpha)mu(b)!=0, alpha^2<=e_+<<E, for which the original progression e=[alpha^2,b]n meets the retained amplitude. Put ell=[alpha^2,b], Q=2sqrt(ND/E) asymp Dsqrt(N/M), and W_(d,ell,U)(q)=A_(D,E,U)(d,4Nd ell^2/q^2). Then S_(D,E,U)=e(1/8)T_(D,E,U)/(N^(1/4)D)+O_(epsilon,V)(X^epsilon), where T=sum_d mu^2(d)(D/d) sum_((alpha,b) in P(d)) mu(alpha)mu(b)chi_4(ell)/ell sum_(q>0,q odd) chi_4(q)W_(d,ell,U)(q)e(Nd ell/q), supported on q asymp ell Q. The exact K=6 stationary/nonstationary ledger, finite DQsqrt(E) progression mass, scaled tail derivative, and dyadic tail sum own every lower symbol, endpoint buffer, negative frequency, and remainder. If g=(ell,q), L=ell/g, q_0=q/g, the correct coordinate is j=NL-Aq_0 with q_0|NL-j; the bare j=N-Aq applies only to ell=1. The transformed target |T|<<RD X^epsilon is not proved.

create.title: Squarefree reciprocal progression-diagonal and source-interface obstruction
create.statement_tex: For a long interior prefix, the literal b=1 cells of the exact Round-148 reciprocal transform contain a common rectangle with odd squarefree alpha, alpha^2 asymp E, q asymp alpha^2 Q, and a d-norm asymp D. Their absolute cell mass is L asymp Qsqrt(E). If coefficient-weighted Cauchy is applied to these unrecombined cells and the d1=d2 term is then majorized separately and positively, every positive weighting has capacity at least sqrt(D)L asymp Qsqrt(DE)=sqrt(N)D=R(RD), losing R over the target. This no-go is confined to that proof placement and is not a signed lower bound; pre-Cauchy regrouping, N-dependent alignments, signed cross-cell energies, and short collar-owned prefixes remain outside it. The arbitrary-outer-q-coefficient analogue is false at D=1, while the absolute squarefree Q+D analogue remains open. With q_*=q/(q,ell N), the full q_*<=Y stratum costs DYX^epsilon and is safe for Y<=R. The audited progression, variance, inverse-square, inverse-fraction, and separable large-sieve interfaces do not prove the actual varying-q coupled sum; Schlage--Puchta's exact-denominator specialization is nonexhaustive and no audited theorem aggregates the other approximants. There is no termwise ell-to-powerful-H map, and the reciprocal j-band is D times wider than the formal H band.
create.next_action: Park progression separation before Cauchy, arbitrary outer coefficients, unproved absolute squarefree Q+D, direct fixed-modulus source import, and a termwise ell=H-index identification. Reopen with a signed joint progression energy, an exact Euler recombination, or a genuinely joint cross-t theorem.
